notes.scope: Outdoor clips whose captions or camera metadata show a street, road, or lane. Indoor and warehouse clips are excluded.
notes.gps: No GPS track exists in the index or in any container. 48 GoPro chunks (GX010001 and GX050001) repeat one ISO 6709 point, +40.7314-073.9896, which reverse-geocodes to 112 East 11th Street, East Village. The point is identical on every chunk, including a chunk whose sign reads Centre Street, so it is a file-level tag, not the path of the ride. GOPR0130 and every CCTV and PIE file have no location tag.
notes.camera_pose: No camera pose, IMU, extrinsics, or calibration in the index or the mp4 files.
notes.mount: dashcam = a camera that travels with a bike or car (GoPro, PIE forward camera). fixed_cctv = a camera that stays on one view (street corners, residential curb, I-24 overhead).
notes.thumbnail: One frame at 1.0 seconds, scaled to 480 px wide, JPEG.
